3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_010
5.description: After securing the wall, a number of soldiers from the Alliance were posted here in the event of retaliation by the imperials.
5.translation_description: Dopo aver messo in sicurezza il muro, alcuni soldati dell’Alleanza sono stati stanziati qui nel caso in cui gli imperiali tentassero una rappresaglia.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_011
6.description: Each of the nations, including Ishgard, has sent in troops to support our efforts here.
6.translation_description: Ogni nazione, Ishgard compresa, ha inviato truppe per sostenere i nostri sforzi qui.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_012
7.description: As one might expect, military procedures and protocol differ from one army to the next, which has admittedly caused problems from time to time. Still, the Garleans have yet to prove a match for our combined forces.
7.translation_description: Com’era prevedibile, le procedure e i protocolli militari variano da un esercito all’altro e, a dire il vero, questo ha causato qualche problema. Tuttavia, finora i Garleani non si sono dimostrati all’altezza delle nostre forze congiunte.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_020
8.description: Castrum Oriens was originally built by the Garleans as a garrison for their troops to maintain Baelsar's Wall.
8.translation_description: Castrum Oriens fu costruito in origine dai Garleani come guarnigione per le truppe incaricate di presidiare Baelsar’s Wall.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_021
9.description: When they first arrived, the people who once occupied the nearby hamlets were forced to flee, most seeking sanctuary in Gridania.
9.translation_description: Quando arrivarono, gli abitanti dei villaggi vicini furono costretti a fuggire; la maggior parte cercò rifugio a Gridania.

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_022
10.description: Sadly this isn't the first time these lands have borne witness to such bloodshed. Nearly one hundred years ago, the king of Ala Mhigo attempted to expand the nation's territory. His attempts to encroach on Gridanian land escalated into what came to be known as the Autumn War.
10.translation_description: Purtroppo, non è la prima volta che queste terre sono testimoni di un simile spargimento di sangue. Quasi cent’anni fa, il re di Ala Mhigo tentò di espandere i confini della nazione. I suoi tentativi di invadere le terre gridaniane diedero origine a quella che passò alla storia come la Guerra d’Autunno.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_023
11.description: In the end, with aid from Limsa Lominsa, Ul'dah, and even Ishgard, Gridania dealt Ala Mhigo a crushing defeat.
11.translation_description: Alla fine, con l’aiuto di Limsa Lominsa, Ul’dah e persino Ishgard, Gridania inflisse ad Ala Mhigo una sconfitta schiacciante.

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTRUMORIENS_00394_SONSTELOT_000_024
12.description: It's almost hard to believe the Alliance now works to save Ala Mhigo rather than fight against them as they did so long ago.
12.translation_description: È quasi incredibile che oggi l’Alleanza si adoperi per salvare Ala Mhigo, invece di combatterla come fece tanto tempo fa.
